newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it killed 23 Kurdish rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it killed 23 Kurdish rebels.

text.p: Turkish forces killed 23 rebel Kurds in clashes in the southeast of the country, the state-run Anatolian news agency said on Thursday.
A statement from the emergency rule governor quoted by the agency said 23 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels were killed and two captured. A further six turned themselves in, it said.
Security forces killed 15 of the guerrillas in the remote Siirt province after rebels killed a shepherd and stole livestock late on Wednesday, the agency said.

Four PKK guerrillas were killed in Diyarbakir province, three in Hakkari and another in Bingol province. A member of the pro-state village guard militia was also killed in Mus province, Anatolian said.
More than 26,000 people have died since 1984 in the struggle between Turkish security forces and the PKK, who are fighting for independence or autonomy in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
